manual.godofthings.creative_energy_cube:
What: Infinite Tier Generator -- an infinite FE source; all six faces output at maximum rate (infinite FE/t).
Obtain: creative tab.
Use: right-click for a GUI that charges you or your items.
manual.godofthings.creature_annihilation:
What: Living Ward Boundary Stone -- while placed, natural mob spawning is blocked within a 512-block radius.
Obtain: crafting.
Use: just place it in your base; no GUI.
manual.godofthings.god_absorber:
What: Myriad Convergence Core -- absorbs item drops and XP over a large area.
Obtain: crafting.
Use: GUI for on/off, range (0-480), stored-XP panel and per-face config; can join an AE2 network.
manual.godofthings.god_accelerator:
What: parallel accelerator -- goes into a God machine's accelerator slot; each one multiplies parallel jobs by 16 (a stack of 64 = x1024).
Obtain: crafting / creative tab.
Use: open the machine GUI and put it in the accelerator slot. Affects miner, resource, drop machines, etc.
manual.godofthings.god_backpack:
What: Sumeru Pouch -- a **120-slot** portable storage; right-click to open (contents travel with the item, and are kept even if it is dropped).
Obtain: 4 leather + 2 netherite ingots + 1 shulker box + 1 All-Things Origin Stone.
GUI:
· **Sort**: reorders by the current key (**By Name / By Mod / By Count / By Tags**; click the small button to cycle).
· **Memory**: click Memory to enter marking mode, then click slots to remember their item; memory slots are **never sorted**, **receive matching items first** when storing, and show a faded ghost when empty.
· **No Sort**: click No Sort, then click slots that should **stay put when sorting** (handy for tools).
· **Search**: filters as you type; non-matching slots look empty; start with `@` to search by mod (e.g. `@minecraft`).
· **Store All / Take All**: move everything between your inventory and the backpack.
· **Ignore Durability / Ignore NBT**: relaxes stacking and matching to the item itself.
· **No nesting**: a Sumeru Pouch cannot be put inside another one; while the GUI is open its own slot is locked.
· **Mouse wheel** scrolls (9 columns x 6 visible rows, 120 slots in total).
· **Keybind**: press `B` to open it (works whether it is in your inventory or equipped in an accessory slot; rebindable in Options - Controls).
· **Accessories**: it can be equipped in the **Curios back slot** and still opened with `B`; **this slot is enabled automatically by this mod** (it appears in the Curios screen after you log in).
manual.godofthings.god_binder:
What: binds a machine to the Aurora Leyline Ferry Hub's wireless charging network.
Obtain: crafting.
Use: right-click a machine to bind it; holding it in the off hand auto-binds machines you place. Can go into the **Master Artisan's Girdle** for quick swapping (press R for the radial wheel): these five god tools are on the belt's internal whitelist, so they are accepted by default (since v5.18.0 the belt is built in -- no external ToolBelt mod needed).
manual.godofthings.god_black_box:
What: pickup filter storage -- whitelist or blacklist mode, no stack limit inside.
Obtain: crafting.
Use: right-click for the filter GUI; scroll while holding it to toggle quickly. Can go into the **Master Artisan's Girdle** for quick swapping (press R for the radial wheel): these five god tools are on the belt's internal whitelist, so they are accepted by default (since v5.18.0 the belt is built in -- no external ToolBelt mod needed).
manual.godofthings.god_boots:
What: Treads of Gods · Soaring -- one of the four God Armor pieces.
Obtain: crafting.
Use: wear all four pieces to activate set features.
manual.godofthings.god_change:
What: time / weather control.
Obtain: crafting.
Use: right-click to open the GUI and pick the time and weather to switch to. Can go into the **Master Artisan's Girdle** for quick swapping (press R for the radial wheel): these five god tools are on the belt's internal whitelist, so they are accepted by default (since v5.18.0 the belt is built in -- no external ToolBelt mod needed).
manual.godofthings.god_chestplate:
What: Aegis of Gods · Immortality -- one of the four God Armor pieces.
Obtain: crafting.
Use: wear all four pieces to activate set features.
manual.godofthings.god_config:
What: a machine configuration template -- copy one machine's setup and paste it onto other machines of the same type.
Obtain: 2 paper + 1 redstone + 1 All-Things Origin Stone (also in the creative tab).
Use: **sneak + right-click a machine** to save (six-face I/O modes + the AE grid switch + the number of Planck Overclock Catalysts in its accelerator slot; only the count is stored, not the items). **Right-click another machine of the same type** to paste: the face modes and the AE switch are written back, and the saved number of accelerators is topped up by **taking Planck Overclock Catalysts from your inventory** (free in creative). If you don't have enough, everything else is still applied and you are told how many are missing; a wrong machine type or an empty card is reported separately. Supported: Blazing Sacred Furnace / Earthrending Skybore Rig / God Ore / God Crop / Genesis Engraving Altar / Purewood Unbark Altar / Myriad Souls Echo Register / Spirit Embryo Sacred Egg.
manual.godofthings.god_craft:
What: Heavenly Artisan Engine -- an advanced crafting table with a config menu, 8 template slots and even-input distribution.
Obtain: crafting.
Use: right-click for the GUI; templates save/reapply your common recipes. Can join an AE2 network.
manual.godofthings.god_devourer:
What: Endless Night Void Well -- a void trash can.
Obtain: crafting.
Use: right-click the block for its GUI; there is also a quick button in the player inventory. **Anything put in vanishes instantly** (manual click, Shift-click, hopper or pipe), so the slots always stay empty.
manual.godofthings.god_drop:
What: Myriad Souls Echo Register -- item collector plus spawn-egg producer. Eggs are not consumed; it rolls the **vanilla loot table** and outputs every drop (e.g. chicken = feather + raw chicken, 64 of each), filtering out weapons/tools/armor so it is not a free-gear machine.
Obtain: crafting.
Use: **since v5.7.0 every mod's spawn egg works** (not just vanilla); put spawn eggs in the input slots (up to 9 in parallel); Planck Overclock Catalyst raises parallelism; can join an AE2 network.
manual.godofthings.god_enchant:
What: Supreme Law Inscription Seat -- pick any enchantment at any level for any item, no conditions, no lapis, up to level 255 (beyond vanilla); selecting an enchantment defaults to 255.
Obtain: crafting.
Use: put an item -> pick an enchantment -> adjust level -> apply; "Batch" applies it at level 255 to every compatible item in your inventory (incompatible ones are skipped).
manual.godofthings.god_furnace:
What: Blazing Sacred Furnace -- a super furnace with JEI / EMI recipe lookup.
Obtain: crafting (this is the root advancement of the mod).
Use: right-click for the GUI and insert your input; since v5.15.5 it can join an AE2 network as a grid node (cable connection, one channel, smelting output auto-pushes into the network, toggle with the AE button at the top right).
manual.godofthings.god_helmet:
What: Crown of Gods · Illumination -- one of the four God Armor pieces.
Obtain: crafting.
Use: with the full set, press O for feature toggles and K for the skill tree (see System - God Armor & Skills).
manual.godofthings.god_invite:
What: God Invite -- gives a mob infinite health.
Obtain: crafting.
Use: right-click a mob; hit feedback is preserved and can be toggled. Can go into the **Master Artisan's Girdle** for quick swapping (press R for the radial wheel): these five god tools are on the belt's internal whitelist, so they are accepted by default (since v5.18.0 the belt is built in -- no external ToolBelt mod needed).
manual.godofthings.god_leggings:
What: Skirt of Gods · Sanctuary -- one of the four God Armor pieces.
Obtain: crafting.
Use: wear all four pieces to activate set features.
manual.godofthings.god_manual:
What: the in-game manual -- every item/block has an entry, look things up here.
Obtain: 1 book + 4 gold ingots + 1 All-Things Origin Stone.
Use: right-click it, press P, or run /godofthings manual. Pick a tab and entry on the left; search on top.
manual.godofthings.god_measure:
What: Heaven-Measuring Golden Ruler -- a tape measure. **Right-click a block** to set the start, right-click again elsewhere to set the end: a wireframe box is drawn showing the X / Y / Z dimensions (keep clicking to start the next box). **Sneak-right-click** undoes the last box; **switching held item / dimension / relogging** clears them all. Measuring is client-side only, zero server cost.
Obtain: crafting (2 gray wool / 2 yellow wool / iron ingot + 1 All-Things Origin Stone).
Use: line color / text color / text size / line width can be tuned in the [measurement] section of config/godofthings-client.toml. Can go into the **Master Artisan's Girdle** for quick swapping (press R for the radial wheel): these five god tools are on the belt's internal whitelist, so they are accepted by default (since v5.18.0 the belt is built in -- no external ToolBelt mod needed).
manual.godofthings.god_miner:
What: Earthrending Skybore Rig -- area mining machine with adjustable efficiency/fortune/silk touch and six configurable faces (input pulls in accelerators, output pushes items and fluids). It also works as a pickaxe.
Obtain: crafting.
Use: right-click for parameters and face config; can join an AE2 network.
manual.godofthings.god_note:
What: Divine Aspiration Tome -- a checklist with checkboxes that supports **sub-tasks** (a main task with sub-tasks, like a heading and subheadings).
Obtain: 3 paper + 1 ink sac + 1 gold ingot + 1 All-Things Origin Stone.
Use: right-click or press N. Up to 8 books per shelf; drag rows to reorder within the same level; the **+ at the end of a row adds a sub-task and Enter keeps the mode so you can add several**; while editing text, Tab demotes it under the previous task and Shift+Tab promotes it; the **triangle at the start of a row folds / unfolds its sub-tasks**; every delete asks twice. Press M to place the overlay. Content is stored per player in the world save.
manual.godofthings.god_slaughter:
What: Twilight Requiem Executioner -- area killing (on/off, range 0-480, looting 0-1600, instant kill).
Obtain: crafting.
Use: GUI for the settings; drops go straight into its own 27-slot infinite storage. Can join an AE2 network.
Protected: armor stands, villagers, wandering traders, tamed pets (wolves, cats, parrots, and horses / donkeys / mules / llamas) and renamed mobs are never killed.
manual.godofthings.god_spawn_egg:
What: Spirit Embryo Sacred Egg -- a spawn-egg duplicator. Put a spawn egg in and it produces the **same** egg; **works with every kind of spawn egg** (vanilla, NeoForge, and modded eggs that follow the vanilla convention of storing the entity data in the item). The whole item stack is copied, data included.
Obtain: 8 All-Things Origin Stones + 1 egg.
Use: right-click for the GUI, put spawn eggs into the 3x3 input slots (up to 9 in parallel; input is not consumed); Planck Overclock Catalysts raise the parallel multiplier; output is pushed downward; can join an AE2 network.
manual.godofthings.god_transmitter:
What: Aurora Leyline Ferry Hub -- wireless FE charging for machines and players, working across dimensions.
Obtain: crafting.
Use: right-click for the four-tab GUI; bind machines with the Concord Pact.
manual.godofthings.god_unbreakable:
What: makes an item unbreakable -- this is a special crafting recipe, not a usable item.
Obtain: look up the recipe in JEI / EMI (craft the item together with Eternal Seal).
Use: combine with the target item; you get the same item with the unbreakable property.
manual.godofthings.hoyoog_fumo:
What: skin plushie -- a full 12-part player model using the standard 64x64 skin UV; texture is the mod author's own skin.
Obtain: crafting.
Use: right-click to toggle its self-rotation (~6 degrees per tick).
manual.godofthings.space_time_eternity:
What: Space Time Eternity -- while placed it locks world time and weather.
Obtain: crafting.
Use: just place it; no GUI.
manual.godofthings.system.ae2:
Nine production machines (miner / resource / drop / **spawn egg** / slaughter / craft / absorber / **furnace** / **peeler**, added in v5.15.5 / v5.15.9) can act as AE grid nodes: just connect a cable (one channel) and their output goes into the network. Each GUI has an AE toggle that only controls pushing output into AE.
Note: **AE2 is required** for this mod to start (those block entities implement AE2 interfaces directly); mods.toml declares it as required.
manual.godofthings.system.ae2.title: AE2 integration
manual.godofthings.system.armor_and_skil:
Wear all four pieces (helmet / chestplate / leggings / boots), then press **K** or **O** for a screen with **three pages** (it remembers the last one; switch with the tabs or `Tab`):
· **God Boosts (7 toggles)**: Myriad Souls Echo Registers / God Mobs / God Blocks / God XP / Spirit Embryo Sacred Eggs / God Heads / God Smelting -- turning one on grants its max level; turning it off remembers the level.
· **God Resonance (7 toggles, off by default)**: lets the matching God-series machine inherit the boost above; the machine benefits only while its owner is **online**, wears the **full set**, and the matching resonance toggle is on.
· **God Armor (8 toggles)**: God Flight / Invincibility / Saturation / Fire Resistance / Breathing / Vision / See-Through / Gluttony.
· **Always on (no toggle)**: Village Hero -- active whenever the full set is worn.
· Rows show only on / off; hover for details. Each page has Turn-all-on / Turn-all-off; levels are saved per player.
manual.godofthings.system.compat:
· Optional integrations: JEI / EMI, Jade, AE2 and its addons (AE2WTLib / ExtendedAE / AppliedFlux / AppMek), Ad Astra, Occultism, Malum, Mystical Agriculture, Goety, Iron's Spells, Ars Nouveau, EnderIO, Mekanism, Productive Bees, Construction Wand, GTCEu. Missing ones are skipped automatically.
· Since v5.9.0 the **wireless logistics were removed entirely**, together with the integrations that only served it (Modern Industrialization energy bridge / Mekanism chemical bridge / FTB Teams ownership / Ars source endpoints).
· Note: the dimensions and the plushie are verbatim ports; with useless_mod / ae2lt installed some of our mixins get overridden -- /godofthings doctor names them. This is intended (upstream updates keep being ported).
manual.godofthings.system.compat.title: Compatibility
manual.godofthings.system.dimensions:
· Void Dimension: enter and leave with the Nethervoid Boundary Stele block.
· Useless Dimensions (ported from useless_mod): odd / even / useless, each with its own teleport block.
· Place a teleport block and walk in. The blocks need a pickaxe (they are in the mineable/pickaxe tag).
manual.godofthings.system.faq:
· Machine idle? Check its GUI toggles and range, whether accelerators are inserted, and the six-face I/O config.
· Cannot find something? Use the search box on top of this manual; it searches names and body text.
· Want to know which mods are active, whether our mixins are overridden, or how big the saved data is? Run /godofthings doctor.
· Backups: /godofthings export note and export points (files in <world>/godofthings/exports/).
· Something unclear or missing here? Tell the author, or check the README content table.
manual.godofthings.system.faq.title: FAQ
manual.godofthings.system.getting_starte:
1. Craft the Blazing Sacred Furnace first -- it is the root advancement and most materials come from it.
2. Add the Earthrending Skybore Rig plus Planck Overclock Catalysts: the miner digs, accelerators multiply parallel jobs (x16 each).
3. Missing materials? Use the God Resource (duplication) or Myriad Souls Echo Register (spawn egg -> vanilla loot table) machine.
4. For convenience: Divine Aspiration Tome (press N) and this manual (press P).
5. All recipes are in JEI / EMI; this manual only explains what things do.
manual.godofthings.system.keys_and_comma:
[Keys] P manual / N note / M place the note overlay / U waypoints / O armor features / K god boosts.
[Commands] /godofthings doctor, export|import note|points, manual.
Every key can be rebound in Options - Controls - God of Things. (The old tool/staff keys and the /godnote, /setpoint, /point, /delpoint commands were removed by request.)
manual.godofthings.system.note:
A checklist with checkboxes, two levels deep: main tasks and sub-tasks. Two ways in: press N or right-click the item.
· Up to 8 books per shelf; the bar on top switches / creates / deletes (delete needs two clicks).
· Drag a row to reorder **within its level** (main tasks among main tasks, sub-tasks within their parent).
· Sub-tasks: click the **+** at the end of a main-task row -- Enter keeps the mode so you can add several; press **Tab** while editing a task's text to demote it under the previous task (Shift+Tab promotes it back).
· The **triangle at the start of a row folds / unfolds sub-tasks** (the overlay follows it too); a main task with sub-tasks shows an (n/m) progress hint.
· Every delete asks twice; deleting a main task removes its sub-tasks as well.
· Overlay: toggle and adjust on the overlay page, or press M to drag it on screen (it snaps to edges).
· The title is customizable; with auto-rename on it follows the current date (e.g. 10.02).
· Content is stored per player; back up with /godofthings export|import note (import auto-backs up first).
manual.godofthings.system.note.title: Divine Aspiration Tome
manual.godofthings.system.waypoints:
· Press **U** for the GUI: edit / delete (two clicks) / pin to top; data is stored per player.
· Since v5.9.0 the /setpoint, /point and /delpoint commands were removed by request -- waypoints are handled through the U-key screen only.
· /godofthings export|import points backs them up under <world>/godofthings/exports/.

manual.godofthings.god_ore_machine:
Gilded Spirit Vault -- accepts ores only: raw ores / ingots / gems and every ore block (including modded ores like GTCEu). Produces ingots / drops per the ore loot table, 64 per cycle.
Craft: 8 All-Things Origin Stones + 1 diamond block.
Usage: put ores in the input slots; Planck Overclock Catalysts add parallelism; can join an AE2 network.
manual.godofthings.god_crop_machine:
Fertility Mother's Hotbed -- accepts crops and plants only: seeds / crops / saplings / kelp / sugar cane / cactus / berries / nether wart and every modded plant. Produces per the harvest loot of a fully grown crop, 64 per cycle. **Modded crops use the same rule**: the seed's crop block is set to full maturity and its own drop logic runs, so Mystical Agriculture's nature seeds yield **nature essence** instead of more seeds.
Craft: 8 All-Things Origin Stones + 1 hay block.
Usage: put crops or saplings in the input slots; Planck Overclock Catalysts add parallelism; can join an AE2 network.
manual.godofthings.god_duplicate_machine:
Genesis Engraving Altar -- accepts everything: any item from vanilla or any mod can be duplicated, 64 per cycle (fast-list blocks and AE2 sky stone every tick, everything else every 20 ticks).
Craft: 8 All-Things Origin Stones + 1 quartz block.
Usage: put any item in the input slots; Planck Overclock Catalysts add parallelism; can join an AE2 network. Outputs are fresh stacks and do not carry the input's enchantments / durability / container contents.
manual.godofthings.god_peeler:
What: Purewood Unbark Altar -- an auto-stripping machine: logs in, matching stripped logs out. Every vanilla log / wood / stem / hyphae / bamboo block works; modded logs are recognized automatically when they follow the usual stripped_ naming convention (already-stripped logs are not accepted).
Obtain: crafting (8 All-Things Origin Stones + 1 iron axe).
Usage: put logs into the 3x3 input slots (9 slots, same layout as the Blazing Sacred Furnace) and take stripped logs from the matching output slots. Hoppers / pipes work per **face config**: the gear button at the top-right opens the face config, where each of the six faces can be None / Input / Output / Both (all default to None -- configure a face before hoppers can interact); input faces auto-pull logs from adjacent containers, output faces auto-push results to them. Every 5 ticks each input slot strips 1 log -- 9 slots in parallel; Planck Overclock Catalysts raise parallelism and slot capacity (x16 each, a full stack of 64 = x1024). Interval configurable in the [peeler] section of godofthings-machines.toml. Since v5.15.9 it can join an AE2 network as a grid node (cable connection, one channel; stripped logs auto-push into the network; toggle with the AE button on the right).
tooltip.godofthings.god_belt: Fully upgraded: %s tool slots. Right-click to open, R for the radial wheel.
manual.godofthings.god_belt:
What: Master Artisan's Girdle -- a 9-slot tool belt that carries tools / weapons / items and swaps the held item with one click. Ported from the ToolBelt mod (BSD-3-Clause, by gigaherz).
Obtain: crafting (4 leather + 3 string + 1 iron ingot + 1 All-Things Origin Stone).
Use: right-click to open the belt screen (9 slots, tools / weapons / non-stackable items go in; god tools such as God Invite / Cloud-Turning Token / Heaven-Measuring Golden Ruler / Miniature Black Hole / God Binder are always accepted); press **V** to open the belt-slot screen (equip the belt + 2x2 crafting + inventory); press **R** to open the radial wheel and swap the held item with any belt slot (the unbound cycle keys move the selection). The belt is always at max level -- no pouch or upgrades needed.
tooltip.godofthings.god_recipe: The base catalyst for every divine creation (older recipes are being migrated onto it)
manual.godofthings.god_recipe:
What: All-Things Origin Stone -- the base catalyst for every divine creation. The four God Armor pieces already use it (vanilla armor shapes with every material slot replaced by All-Things Origin Stone: helmet 5 / chestplate 8 / leggings 7 / boots 4); other god items (God Binder, all machines, ...) will follow the same "All-Things Origin Stone + a few materials" pattern, and that migration only touches recipe json, never the items themselves.
Obtain: shaped crafting -- one iron ingot / copper ingot / gold ingot / diamond / netherite ingot / emerald / redstone / lapis lazuli / coal filling a 3x3 (top row iron, copper, gold; middle diamond, netherite, emerald; bottom redstone, lapis, coal).
Use: no interaction, just a crafting material.
manual.godofthings.god_construction:
What: Worldweaver Staff -- a port of the construction stick: batch-places blocks, sneak-right-click cycles the mode, an off-hand block enables replacement, and it pulls materials from a linked AE network.
Obtain: 1 All-Things Origin Stone + 2 netherite ingots.
Use: **right-click a block runs the current mode** (build / destroy / replace; sneak-right-click cycles). Build spreads across the plane of the clicked face (the block behind every cell must match) up to 1024 blocks; right-clicking air places an off-hand block 2 blocks ahead (angel). Destroy breaks up to 81 connected blocks of the same kind with **no drops** (blocks with block entities -- chests, machines -- can be destroyed too, their contents are lost). Replace needs a block in the **off-hand**, swaps the whole connected area, pops the old blocks and consumes one new block per cell. The tool never wears out (unbreakable). **Sneak + right-click air** opens the settings screen: switch modes, **undo the last action (up to 10 steps)**, and toggle the **preview outline** and **similar-block matching** (treat block variants such as stone-brick types as one). A block in your **off-hand takes priority for building** (materials are taken from the off-hand first). Blocks that **open a GUI** by right-click (chests, machines) keep opening it -- **hold Ctrl while right-clicking** to force construction instead. Put it into a Wireless Access Point's link slot to bind an ME network; missing materials are extracted automatically.
message.godofthings.god_construction.nee: Replace mode needs the block to place in your off-hand
message.godofthings.god_construction.no_: No usable blocks (not in your inventory nor the ME network)
manual.godofthings.heavenly_construction:
What: Heaven-Opening Authority -- the god-tier version of Worldweaver Staff. Exactly the same controls (**right-click** runs the current mode, **sneak-right-click** cycles it, **sneak-right-click air** opens the settings screen with the 10-step undo, preview outline and similar-block matching), but all three limits are pushed to the **int maximum**: blocks placed per action, blocks destroyed per action, and the angel (mid-air) placement distance. Durability is unlimited as well (no durability bar).
Obtain: crafting (**1 Worldweaver Staff + 8 All-Things Origin Stones** in a ring).
Use: same as Worldweaver Staff. Because one action can hit hundreds of thousands of blocks, the server runs it in batches of **8192 blocks per tick** and continues across ticks; walking away / swapping hands / logging out cancels the remainder (what was already done still goes into the undo history). A block in your **off-hand takes priority for building** (materials come from the off-hand first). Blocks that **open a GUI** by right-click keep opening it -- **hold Ctrl while right-clicking** to force construction. AE extraction works too: link the wand in a Wireless Access Point's link slot.
manual.godofthings.natures_compass:
What: Nature's Compass -- a biome locator. Full port of [Nature's Compass](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/natures-compass) by ChaosTheDude (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0).
Obtain: crafting (4 Saplings + 4 Logs + 1 Compass, in the vanilla compass shape); repair a damaged one with 4 String + 1 Lapis Lazuli.
Use:
- **Right-click** opens the screen. The left list holds every biome in the world, sortable six ways in a cycle (name / source mod / tags / dimension / rainfall / temperature).
- Pick a biome, then **Start Search**: the server spiral-samples the world and checks biome connectivity to find the nearest match. The screen live-reports search radius and samples taken; **Search for Next** keeps going.
- Once found it shows coordinates / dimension / distance / biome details (temperature, precipitation, top block, filler block, height variation, ...). The **Teleport** button follows the config settings for permission.
- Searching costs durability; you can disable durability loss or raise the search radius in the config.
- Config: `config/godofthings-natures-compass.toml` (common: max radius / max samples / durability / teleport permission / blacklist) and `godofthings-natures-compass-client.toml` (client: HUD position and what it shows).
manual.godofthings.explorers_compass:
What: Explorer's Compass -- a structure locator. Full port of [Explorer's Compass](https://github.com/MattCzyr/ExplorersCompass) by ChaosTheDude (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0).
Obtain: crafting (4 Cobwebs + 4 Cracked Stone Bricks + 1 Compass).
Use:
- **Right-click** opens the screen. The left list holds every structure that actually generates in this save (villages, strongholds, ocean monuments, woodland mansions, ancient cities, modded structures, ...), sortable four ways in a cycle (name / source mod / group / dimension).
- Pick a structure, then **Start Search**: the server dispatches the matching algorithm for that structure's placement type (random spread / concentric rings / generic) and the screen live-reports progress. **Search for Next** keeps going.
- Once found it shows coordinates / dimension / distance / structure name; you can **Teleport** straight there or **clear** the result.
- Only structures that really exist in this save are listed (following the world seed and installed mods), so a search never comes back empty for a structure the world does not have.
- Config: `config/godofthings-explorers-compass.toml` (common: search radius / teleport permission) and `godofthings-explorers-compass-client.toml` (client: HUD and screen appearance).

manual.godofthings.infinity_biginteger_c:
What: "Devouring Silence of Eternity of Ten Thousand Voices" -- the ultimate ME storage cell (full port of ExtendedAE+ 1.6.3, LGPL-3.0). Unlike the four fixed-resource infinity cells, this one is generic:
Capacity: backed by BigInteger, effectively unlimited. AE2 screens can only show a long, so a single item tops out at 9.2E (9,223,372,036,854,775,808) in the terminal -- but you can keep inserting past that and nothing is lost; the excess is still accounted for exactly.
Types: unlimited. Items / fluids / any AE2-integrated resource (FE, chemicals, source, ...) can be stored; the latter need their respective addon installed.
Specs: 512 AE/t idle drain; 4 upgrade slots (inverter / fuzzy / capacity ...) plus a config slot for partition filtering; refuses to store a non-empty cell of its own kind (no recursion).
Where the data lives: not on the item -- in the world save at world/data/infinity_biginteger_cells.dat, with the item carrying only a UUID (so removing / replacing / dropping the cell never loses data). Field names match upstream, so saves are interchangeable.
Recovery: if the cell is ever lost, the data is still in the save; /godofthings infinity recover hands you a cell for every dataset stored there.
Obtain: crafting (4 Quartz Glass + 4 All-Things Origin Stones + 1 256k Cell Component + 1 Nether Star + 2 Netherite Ingots).
message.godofthings.infinity.need_player: This command must be run by a player (it hands the cells to you)
message.godofthings.infinity.no_data: No recoverable "Devouring Silence of Eternity" data in this save
message.godofthings.infinity.recovered: Re-issued %s cell(s) from the save data
manual.godofthings.universal_cell:
What: Primordial Myriad Crystal -- one cell infinitely supplies 5 resources at once: Water, Lava, Cobblestone, Blank Pattern, and Fluix ME Glass Cable (ae2:fluix_glass_cable).
Capacity: reports 9,223,372,036,854,775,807 (9.2E) to AE2 -- the long ceiling of AE2 KeyCounter and the largest unit AE2 can display (its unit table is KMGTPE, E is the max). With multiple cells the KeyCounter clamp plus exact BigInteger accounting keep it from overflowing negative or hiding stacks from the terminal.
Behaviour: phantom storage from a fixed list -- inserting matching resources is accepted but not stored; no durability, no NBT, identical after removal and reinsertion. Idle drain 8 AE/t.
Obtain: crafting (4 Quartz Glass + 4 All-Things Origin Stones + 1 256k Cell Component + 1 Water Bucket + 1 Lava Bucket).
Note: this cell replaces the old four single-resource cells (water / lava / cobblestone / blank pattern).

tooltip.godofthings.god_belt.shift_1: §e[Wheel] §fPress R for the radial wheel and swap the main-hand tool with a belt slot instantly.
tooltip.godofthings.god_belt.shift_2: §a[Portable Workshop] §fPress V for the carry UI (2x2 crafting and armor slot access); freely dyeable.
tooltip.godofthings.natures_compass.lore: §6§o"As the needle turns, the pulse of mountains, rainforests and deep seas lies fully in view."
tooltip.godofthings.natures_compass.desc: §7Biome pathfinding instrument. Massive spiral sampling locates and teleports to any chosen biome.
tooltip.godofthings.god_slaughter.lore: §6§o"Where judgment falls, the unsanctioned turn to ash; only the essence remains."
tooltip.godofthings.god_slaughter.desc: §7Large-area auto killer. Up to level 255 Looting; drops and XP go straight to internal storage.
tooltip.godofthings.god_slaughter.shift_: §e[Range & Execute] §fSpherical radius 0-480 adjustable; the execute toggle deals Float.MAX true damage.
§a[Absolute Protection] §fHardcoded: tamed pets, villagers, wandering traders and every named mob.
§b[Zero Lag] §fDrops are intercepted into 4096 internal slots without spawning entities; AE2 extraction supported.
tooltip.godofthings.god_absorber.lore: §6§o"The vault of heaven draws down; all wealth and creation under the stars gather here."
tooltip.godofthings.god_absorber.desc: §7All-dimension vacuum. Absorbs dropped items and experience orbs from extreme range.
tooltip.godofthings.god_absorber.shift_1: §e[Range] §fSpherical radius 0-480 adjustable with a one-click toggle.
tooltip.godofthings.god_absorber.shift_2: §a[XP Pool] §fVast internal XP pool with armor multiplier bonuses; withdraw by 1/10/100 levels or all.
tooltip.godofthings.god_absorber.shift_3: §b[Storage] §f4096 item types stored independently, each slot holding tens of billions; six-face I/O and AE2.
tooltip.godofthings.teleport_block.lore: §6§o"Creation begins; reach the first realm the gods carved out."
tooltip.godofthings.teleport_block.desc: §7Odd-dimension teleport cornerstone. Right-click to teleport, sneak-right-click for the platform customization panel.
tooltip.godofthings.creature_annihilatio: §6§o"Within the boundary, living things retreat; mortal frames may not emerge here."
§7Natural spawn suppression ward. Absolutely forbids natural spawning within 512 blocks.
§a[Exemptions] §fOnly blocks natural spawning; spawners, eggs, breeding and mod-forced spawns are unaffected.
tooltip.godofthings.god_change.lore: §6§o"Flick the golden wheel between your fingers; sun, moon and storms turn in an instant."
tooltip.godofthings.god_change.desc: §7Portable dimensional weather controller. Adjust day/night and clear/rain/storm freely at no cost.
tooltip.godofthings.god_change.shift_1: §e[One-click] §fRight-click for direct buttons: morning, noon, midnight, clear, rain, thunderstorm, without advancing the day count.
tooltip.godofthings.god_black_box.lore: §6§o"A box holding Mount Sumeru, the void storing all things; keep or discard at will, all filth removed."
tooltip.godofthings.god_black_box.desc: §7Smart pickup black hole and high-dimensional storage box. Keeps drops from filling your inventory or littering the world.
tooltip.godofthings.god_black_box.shift_: §e[Filtering] §fRight-click for a 15-slot filter panel; switch blacklist / whitelist instantly.
§a[Boundless Capacity] §fKept items count truly without limit (bypassing the 99 stack cap).
§b[Shortcuts] §fSneak-scroll to toggle while held; sneak-right-click a container to transfer; sneak-right-click the void block to purge.
tooltip.godofthings.god_construction.lor: §6§o"Where the staff points, a thousand-zhang terrace rises and jade towers form in an instant."
tooltip.godofthings.god_construction.des: §7Wear-free building staff. Supports build, destroy and replace modes.
tooltip.godofthings.god_construction.shi: §e[Limits] §fUp to 1024 blocks per action; supports angel placement in air (2 blocks along your sight).
§a[Modes] §fSneak-right-click cycles modes; sneak-right-click air opens the menu (10-step undo and block matching).
§b[Materials] §fPulls from off-hand and inventory first, and can draw from an AE2 wireless access point.
tooltip.godofthings.god_boots.lore: §6§o"Tread the void as solid ground; walk the gale without a speck of dust."
tooltip.godofthings.god_boots.desc: §7God set component. Unlocks inertia-free fast flight with no mining slowdown in the air.
tooltip.godofthings.god_unbreakable.lore: §6§o"Brand the divine stigma; from now on neither time nor ruin can harm it in the slightest."
tooltip.godofthings.god_unbreakable.desc: §7Immortal seal. Grants any mortal equipment the eternal law of Unbreakable.
tooltip.godofthings.god_unbreakable.shif: §e[Application] §fCraft it with any equipment in a table, or hold it in the off-hand and right-click the main-hand item.
tooltip.godofthings.teleport_block_3.lor: §6§o"End and beginning turn; reach the third realm the gods carved out."
tooltip.godofthings.teleport_block_3.des: §7Triple-dimension teleport cornerstone. Right-click to teleport, sneak-right-click for the platform customization panel.
tooltip.godofthings.god_spawn_egg.lore: §6§o"The mother-body left from creation, breeding the primal spark of every living thing."
tooltip.godofthings.god_spawn_egg.desc: §7Dedicated spawn-egg clone machine preserving all entity NBT and custom data.
tooltip.godofthings.god_spawn_egg.shift_: §e[NBT Copy] §fPreserves modded entity data, name tags and custom attributes; the source egg is not consumed.
§a[Speed] §f17 slots in parallel, one batch (64 base) every 20 ticks.
§b[AE2 Grid] §fDirect network link; built-in capacity guard pauses whole rounds when storage is full.
tooltip.godofthings.god_note.lore: §6§o"Thought and longing become destiny; set down this tome and be ferried forward."
tooltip.godofthings.god_note.desc: §7Portable tree-shaped to-do book. Supports primary/subtask levels, collapsing and screen overlay.
tooltip.godofthings.god_note.shift_1: §e[Shortcuts] §fN opens the manager panel; M overlays the current to-do list on the game screen.
